citations.desc: Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries.
citations.narrative:
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:02 PM on
28JUL2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by speaking with the attendant in charge (who spoke on
behalf of the licensee), who confirmed no availability of the licensee or other staff to assist for an inspection. Failure to
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action.
End Section

2.126(b) 
   
Access and inspection of records and property; submission of itineraries. 
A responsible adult was not available to accompany APHIS Officials during the inspection process at 1:02 PM on 
28JUL2026. The inspector attempted to contact the licensee by speaking with the attendant in charge (who spoke on 
behalf of the licensee), who confirmed no availability of the licensee or other staff to assist for an inspection. Failure to 
provide access to the facility, animals, and records for inspection is a violation of the AWA and regulations. Continued 
failure to provide access is serious and may result in enforcement action. 
 
 
End Section
